dashboard.title: Benchmarking
dashboard.description: Studies across the four stages, the actions they produced and the practices adopted.

plan.title: Benchmarking plan {{year}}
plan.description: Studies whose plan request was approved, by target quarter. Circulating sends the plan to the responsible units.

studies.title: Benchmarking studies
studies.description: Each study runs through Plan → Search → Acquire → Analysis with a PM Office gate at each step.

study.closureHint: The PM Office approves the closure; every linked action must be completed with evidence.

search.title: Candidate entities
search.hint: Pick entities from the register or add new ones; select those to compare with, give the reason and acknowledge the code of conduct, then submit to the PM Office.

visits.title: Visit information
visits.hint: One entry per selected entity: agreed date, method, participants, questionnaire and notes.

analysis.subject: Practice
analysis.planHint: When the PM Office approves the analysis, each item becomes a CAP remark (with its proposed action) on the study's source.

actions.title: Corrective actions from this study
actions.notYet: Actions appear here once the PM Office approves the analysis.

impact.title: Impact follow-up
impact.hint: Review whether the improvements were implemented and moved the KPIs (due {{date}}).

comparators.title: Comparator register
comparators.description: Organisations compared with, their sector and scope, contacts, ratings and study history.
comparators.name: Entity
comparators.noHistory: Not used in a study yet.

practices.title: Best-practice library
practices.description: Practices adopted from studies or added by the PM Office, searchable by keyword or by a question.
practices.ask: Ask: e.g. how do others shorten approvals?

settings.title: Benchmarking
settings.description: Search notice before the target quarter, impact follow-up and KPI benchmark update.
settings.kpiBenchmarkUpdate: Update KPI benchmark values on analysis approval
settings.kpiBenchmarkUpdateHint: Only for indicator rows marked "Update the KPI benchmark".

ai.analysisHint: Draft practices and improvements are added to the tables for you to review.

currentStatus.addTopic: Add at least one topic to the plan request and submit it.
currentStatus.waitingSubmit: The plan request is waiting to be submitted.
currentStatus.waitingSearch: Fill in the search form and submit it (notice on {{date}}).
currentStatus.correctSearch: The PM Office returned the search: correct and resubmit.
currentStatus.waitingVisit: Record the visit information, then send the study to analysis.
currentStatus.addAction: Add at least one development plan item before submitting the analysis.
currentStatus.waitingAnalysis: Complete the analysis and the development plan, then submit.
currentStatus.correctAnalysis: The PM Office returned the analysis: correct and resubmit.
currentStatus.followActions: Follow the corrective actions: {{done}} of {{total}} completed.
currentStatus.readyForClosure: All actions are completed with evidence: request the closure.

myWork.resubmit: Correct and resubmit the plan request
myWork.closure: Follow the actions and request closure

errors.actionsOpen: Every linked action must be completed with evidence before closure.
errors.emptyPlan: Add at least one development plan item.
errors.invalidTransition: This step is not possible in the current stage.
errors.noCandidate: Select at least one entity with the code of conduct acknowledged.
errors.noPlanItem: The development plan has no item.
errors.notCompleted: The study is not completed yet.
errors.notSelected: The entity is not selected in this study.
errors.quarterInPast: The target quarter is already over.
